product.name: CoinTracker Crypto Tax Software
product.description: A cloud-based platform that imports cryptocurrency activity, calculates gains, losses, income, and tax liability, and generates reports for tax filing.

product.name: CoinTracker Portfolio Tracker
product.description: A portfolio monitoring tool that consolidates cryptocurrency balances, transaction history, performance, net worth, gains, and losses across connected wallets and exchanges.

product.name: CoinTracker Full Service
product.description: A managed cryptocurrency tax-preparation service that provides hands-off support through a dedicated account-management team for users with more complex tax situations.

product.description: An enterprise tax-compliance solution for cryptocurrency brokers and digital-asset businesses that need to support transaction reporting and customer tax documentation.
